jobs.occupation: Trainee / Specialist – Geospatial Data Engineering & Spatial Pipelines (m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Organization: IRIS – Institut für raumbezogene Infrastruktur und Raumforschung (gGmbH) 

Location: Germany (On-site / Hybrid with Relocation & Housing Support) 

Target Program: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) / Master Trainees / International Talents 

Working Language: English (No initial German language skills required) 

About the Research Institute: 

The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) is a non-profit, applied research institute dedicated to developing cutting-edge spatial resilience data models and open-data architectures for the energy transition, critical infrastructure, and sustainable regional planning. 

What We Offer: 

We provide comprehensive administrative support for international candidates, including full assistance with the German Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte), degree recognition, and visa procedures. You will receive structured onboarding, local accommodation support, coverage of basic living expenses during training, on-site sponsored German language courses, and access to a modern data engineering tech stack centered on Python, PostGIS, Docker, and GIS platforms. 

Your Role & Key Tasks: 

In this role, you will build and maintain automated Python-based spatial data pipelines connecting to WFS services, REST APIs, and public open-data platforms. You will implement spatial overlay and inference models for energy grid matching and land-use analysis, while validating, structuring, and transforming vector geometries into our central PostgreSQL and PostGIS databases. 

Candidate Profile & Qualifications: 

We welcome applicants with a completed university degree in Geoinformatics, Computer Science, Data Science, Environmental Engineering, or a related technical discipline. You should bring practical experience or a strong learning interest in Python (GeoPandas, Shapely), SQL databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS), spatial reference systems, and automated data ingestion workflows. High motivation and fluent English skills are required. 

How to Apply: 

Please submit your CV along with a short cover letter in English. We look forward to welcoming you to the IRIS team! jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)

Then we would love to meet you.

We are a modern, family-owned dental practice located in the beautiful Northern Black Forest region of Germany.

Many of our patients have trusted us for years—often for generations. We know our patients personally, take time for them, and believe that excellent dentistry begins with trust and personal relationships.

We combine state-of-the-art technology with a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

Our practice offers:

- Digital dentistry
- CAD/CAM technology with same-day crowns
- High-quality prosthetic dentistry
- Modern diagnostics
- Professional preventive care
- A friendly and experienced team

We believe that exceptional quality requires time, dedication, and attention to every individual patient.

Your Career Path

We are looking for dentists from abroad who would like to complete their professional recognition and obtain their dental license in Germany.

You will begin working as a Dental Assistant while becoming familiar with the German healthcare system, our clinical procedures, and everyday practice.

During this time, we will actively support you throughout your recognition process until you achieve your goal of becoming a licensed dentist in Germany.

We already have experience successfully guiding an international dentist through this process and understand both the professional and personal challenges involved.

What We Offer

✔ Support during the professional recognition process

✔ A small and welcoming family-oriented team

✔ Modern equipment and digital workflows

✔ High-quality dentistry

✔ Excellent long-term career opportunities

✔ A respectful, supportive and appreciative working environment

An International Team

Moving to a new country can be challenging—but you won't be alone.

In our practice we speak:

🇩🇪 German

🇬🇧 English

Our team members also speak:

🇷🇺 Russian

🇺🇿 Uzbek

🇹🇷 Turkish

This multicultural environment helps many new colleagues feel comfortable from their very first day.

Live Where Others Spend Their Holidays

Our practice is located in one of Germany's most beautiful regions—the Northern Black Forest.

Here you'll enjoy:

- Beautiful forests and nature
- Excellent quality of life
- Safe and peaceful surroundings
- Easy access to Karlsruhe, Pforzheim and Stuttgart

Many international colleagues appreciate the relaxed lifestyle and welcoming community that our region offers.

Who We Are Looking For

You are a great fit if you:

- Graduated in Dentistry outside Germany
- Would like to build your future in Germany
- Minimum B1 German language level (better B2)
- Motivated to improve your German
- Enjoy working with people
- Are reliable, friendly and committed
- Appreciate teamwork and continuous learning

Let's Build Your Future Together

If you are looking for a practice that truly believes in your potential and wants to help you succeed, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Your journey to a successful dental career in Germany can begin here.

We look forward to getting to know you!

For the International Montessori School **in Berlin-Wannsee **we are looking for an

English-Speaking Primary School Teacher

Ref. Nr. 376DR-BA

Your Employer

Montessori & Friends Education gGmbH is an innovative educational institution that runs several children’s centres, the International Bilingual Montessori Primary School and its own Montessori Academy. These facilities create nurturing learning environments for children based on the educational philosophy of Maria Montessori. At the primary school, 130 children learn in mixed-age groups on the grade-levels 1-6. The historic school building is situated in an idyllic location not far from Lake Wannsee. The opening of a secondary school on the same site is planned for the 2026/27 academic year. The school’s aim is to promote self-directed learning and support the holistic development of the children. Another key focus of the school is bilingual education. Around half of the pupils come from English-speaking or bilingual homes and are taught bilingually from grade 1 in both German and English.

Your Responsibilities

As a teacher, you will guide a maximum of 24 students in mixed-age learning groups (grades 1–3) and provide them with individualized support. You will be actively supported by a co-teacher. You will teach all standard elementary school subjects exclusively in English and work according to the principles of Montessori pedagogy. A trusting partnership with parents is just as important as your own creative freedom.

The school offers you 

- a permanent, full-time position,
- competitive compensation, as well as additional benefits and bonuses,
- Childcare spots for your own children in the school’s own daycare centers and at the school, subject to availability,
- regular professional development opportunities and a chance to gain an internationally recognized Montessori-Diploma,
- a supportive team and a friendly, family-like work environment.

This opportunity is for you if

- you have a teaching qualification recognised in the Federal State of Berlin, such as a Master of Education, a German 2. Staatsexamen für die Grundschule/Sekundarstufe I, a foreign teaching degree, or (N)QTS.
- you have already gained experience teaching English at the primary school level,
- you have a Montessori diploma or practical Montessori experience, and the willingness to earn a Montessori diploma while working at the school,
- you have a minimum of a C1 level in English and a minimum of a B1 level in German,
- you enjoy working in a team and cooperating closely with parents and caregivers.

Have we piqued your interest?

If so, we look forward to receiving your application, including your CV and details of your relevant qualifications. Please send your application, quoting reference number 376DR-BA, via email (info@lehrcare.de) in PDF format, to Dorottya Toth, who will be happy to provide you with further information.
